headlines.title: Kornacki Cam: Watch Steve analyze Massachusetts primary election results
headlines.description: NBC News chief data analyst Steve Kornacki breaks down real-time vote tallies from primary elections in Massachusetts, while giving viewers a behind-the-scenes look at election night coverage.

headlines.title: Alaska finalizes Senate race for November: 3 Republicans, including 2 named Dan Sullivan, and 1 Democrat
headlines.description: Former Rep. Mary Peltola will be the only Democrat on the ballot after Democrat David Leslie, who finished fourth in the primary, withdrew.

headlines.title: Whistleblower says USPS system Trump ordered for mail ballots is flawed and untested
headlines.description: An executive order from Trump, which is stymied in the courts, required the Postal Service to rapidly build a complex system to vet mail ballots.

headlines.title: No plans for ICE to be at polls for midterms, DHS says
headlines.description: A senior DHS official said ICE will do its regular duties on the day of midterm elections, though Secretary Markwayne Mullin said agents would enter a polling place to serve a warrant.

headlines.title: Key Texas county votes to cut polling sites ahead of the midterms
headlines.description: Officials in Tarrant County, the third most-populous in Texas, approved a plan to reduce the number of polling locations by 92 compared to the 2022 elections.

headlines.title: U.S. strikes targets in Iran near Strait of Hormuz as Iran says it is retaliating
headlines.description: President Trump said that the U.S. launched “large and powerful” strikes on Iranian targets near the Strait of Hormuz. U.S. Central Command said that it had targeted “Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) targets in Iran.” In response, Iran’s armed forces general staff said that it would retaliate. NBC News' Keir Simmons reports.

headlines.title: What the jury must consider while deciding Lindsay Clancy's fate
headlines.description: As the jury considers the arguments presented by the prosecution and defense in Lindsay Clancy's murder trial, NBC News legal analyst Misty Marris and correspondent Steven Romo break down the instructions the 9 women and 3 men were given before heading into deliberations.

headlines.title: Colin Kaepernick is done with the NFL. He isn’t done fighting.
headlines.description: Ten years after taking a knee to stand against racism and police brutality at great cost to his career and finances, Colin Kaepernick is back in the spotlight.

headlines.title: House passes short-term funding bill to prevent a shutdown before the election
headlines.description: The legislation, which already passed the Senate, now goes to President Donald Trump to become law, checking off the main item on Congress’ to-do list ahead of the midterms.

headlines.title: Customers are losing their appetites over disturbing AI-generated menus
headlines.description: AI “slop” is increasingly on offer at brick-and-mortar establishments.

headlines.title: Student who felt ‘humiliated’ by ICE ankle monitor dies by suicide
headlines.description: Pierre Damas Bel, 20, expressed feeling “shame and humiliation” at having to wear by an ankle monitor. The college student died by suicide days later.

headlines.title: Staten Island man survives lightning strike
headlines.description: Rare video captures the moment Thomas Fahmy is struck by lightning and drops to the ground in agony. Fahmy shares with NBC News’ Erin McLaughlin what he felt when it happened and how he survived.
